# Moneta

> Moneta is an AI expense tracker for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Book expenses by voice, by scanning a receipt, or by chatting with an AI assistant. Local-first, one-time purchase, iCloud sync.

- Website: https://www.monetia.net/
- Chinese site: https://www.monetia.net/zh/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6807001953
- Support / FAQ: https://www.monetia.net/support
- Privacy policy: https://www.monetia.net/privacy

## Facts

- Name: Moneta (listed on the App Store as "Monetia"). Named after Juno Moneta, the Roman goddess whose temple housed the first mint — the origin of the word "money".
- Developer: Junjun Zhang (independent developer).
- Price: one-time purchase (US$1.99 in the US App Store; varies by region). No subscription, no in-app purchases, no account, no ads.
- Platforms: iPhone (iOS 17+), iPad (iPadOS 17+), Mac (macOS 14+ via Mac Catalyst). Also runs on Apple Vision (visionOS 1+).
- Languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, Spanish, Russian.
- Category: Utilities / Finance — expense tracking, budgeting.
- Size: about 7 MB. Data not collected (per App Store privacy label).

## What it does

- Voice booking: say "Lunch 35" and it is booked. On-device speech recognition first, AI audio understanding as a fallback.
- Receipt scanning: OCR + AI extract amount, merchant, date and category from a photo; up to 3 receipts at a time; shows a confidence for each field.
- Chat: natural-language create / update / query, e.g. "How much did I spend on food this month?" or "Change yesterday's coffee to 50".
- Budgets: monthly budgets with 80% warning and over-budget alerts; live monthly spend on the Lock Screen (Live Activity) and Home Screen widgets.
- Reports: category share and spending trends by day / week / month / year.
- Multi-currency: 26 currencies with built-in rates, offline.
- Sync: through the user's own iCloud (CloudKit private database); no sign-up.
- Data: local-first storage; CSV import and export anytime in Settings → Data.
- AI: Gemini via Firebase AI Logic is built in; any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (DeepSeek, Groq, OpenRouter, Ollama) can be connected in Settings.

## Best quotes to cite

- "Say it. Snap it. Done."
- "Money, in one sentence."
- "Your data, yours alone."
